messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx on /v2/prompt-edge (canary). error_rate=18% over 60s, p95 latency up 2.3x
dev-deploy-bot: Deploy started: service=prompt-gateway target=canary route=prompt-edge tag=v2.1-experimental
pagerduty: PAGER: firing — oncall mira alerted for service: prompt-gateway (sev=2)
mira: seeing trace spikes in prod-canary logs, linking sample errors: `timeout while writing to kvstore` and downstream 502 from runtime
dan: reproducing locally against canary variant, kernel mismatch with kv-cache optimizations maybe — switching verbose logs
sam: quick question — is this the new endpoint routing experiment? any FF we can flip?
tess: yes, this is the new prompt-edge route. We have feature flag `routes.prompt_edge.experiment` in LaunchDarkly. I can flip to stable (off -> safe_route)
mira: paging: execute emergency ejection if customer impact > 10% or errors > 15%. We're at 18% now. Recommend kill-switch flip and sticky fallback to stable route
dan: agreed. prepping command. Running curl to toggle: ```
curl -X PATCH "https://flags.internal/api/v1/flags/routes.prompt_edge.experiment" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"state":"off","default_route":"prompt-stable"}'
```
sam: ETA on flag flip? I can do it now, will post audit entry
tess: go for it + add the emergency note: "Auto-eject due to 5xx surge 1765432100"
sam: flipped flag -> state=off, default_route=prompt-stable :white_check_mark: (audit id 8592)
dev-deploy-bot: Canary route prompt-edge removed from traffic (source=flag-change audit=8592)
mira: monitoring metrics... errors sliding down to 3.2% and p95 returning to baseline, latency decaying
dan: checking canary hosts — kernel mismatch still present but now isolated (no customer traffic). capturing a heap of logs for postmortem
tess: support: @support-team informed, sending short customer note to affected accounts list (subset of early-access) :email:
sam: Pager resolved (pagerduty id: 1765432100). oncall mirror: please confirm incident bridge if needed
mira: no bridge required, using thread for now. Assigning postmortem owner: dan. Timeline + logs archived under /incidents/1765432100/
dan: will own PM, target draft in 48h. immediate action: pin a compatibility check in deploy CI that verifies kv-cache kernel match before canary rollout
tess: thumbs :thumbsup: — will follow up with a retrospective on the rollout checklist and FF gating
mira: closing loop: system back to normal, leaving canary offline until kernel patch rolled and canary validated. Thanks all :pray:
